E2-2018-T4-P1-S2.trunk: 主句：There are a number of approaches to mastering the art of deep work（掌握深度工作有多种方法）
structure: 存在句：There are a number of approaches
└ 介词短语作后置定语：to mastering the art of deep work
├ lengthy retreats dedicated to a specific task
└ taking a 'journalistic' approach to seizing moments of deep work when you can throughout the day
E2-2018-T4-P1-S2.logic: 主句提出方法多样，be it之后列举长期闭关、每日仪式和随时抓住机会三种路线。
notes: approach to中的to是介词，所以后接mastering。
be it A, B, or C是让步列举结构，意为“无论是A、B还是C”。
when you can后省略seize moments of deep work。

E2-2018-T4-P1-S8.trunk: 主句：Tim Harford points to a study（蒂姆·哈福德提到一项研究）
structure: └ 同位语：author of Messy: The Power of Disorder to Transform Our Lives
谓语宾语：points to a study in the early 1980s
└ 定语从句(that)：that divided undergraduates into two groups
├ 分句①：some were advised to set out monthly goals and study activities
└ 分句②：others were told to plan activities and goals in much more detail, day by day
E2-2018-T4-P1-S8.logic: 主句引入研究，that从句说明分组方式，冒号后的两个被动句具体交代两组收到的不同规划建议。
notes: point to在此意为“援引、提到”。
advise sb to do与tell sb to do在句中都用了被动语态。
set out goals意为“列出、制定目标”。

E2-2018-T4-P1-S12.trunk: 引语主干：Idleness is not just A; it is as indispensable to the brain as vitamin D is to the body; idleness is necessary to getting work done（闲散不只是A；它对大脑不可或缺；而且是完成工作的必要条件）
structure: 分句①：Idleness is not just a vacation, an indulgence or a vice
分号后分句②：it is as indispensable to the brain as vitamin D is to the body
省略号后总结：idleness is, paradoxically, necessary to getting any work done
E2-2018-T4-P1-S12.logic: 三层递进先否定对闲散的贬义理解，再用维生素D类比其必要性，最后得出看似矛盾的结论：休息是工作的前提。
notes: not just A承接后文更强的判断，不宜只译为简单并列。
as indispensable to A as B is to C表示“对A而言，就像B对C一样不可或缺”。
be necessary to中的to是介词，故后接getting。
